frame._note: This section adds the device frame around the app screenshot. You can choose between 'android', 'ios' for the type, and specify the cutout style 'pill', 'punch-hole' or 'none'.

fonts._note: To change the fonts, just replace the font names below with any Google Fonts of your choice. https://fonts.google.com/
fonts.heading: Montserrat

palette._note: You can customize the color palette for your app. The primary color is used for buttons and highlights, accent color for secondary actions, and surface color for backgrounds. Try https://color.adobe.com/ to generate a palette.

hero._note: This is the hero section of your app landing page. You can customize the title, subtitle, main text, and screenshot image. Try to keep your screenshots under 500 KB for faster loading.
hero.subtitle: Soo bëgg sore ci sa digganteek Yàlla
hero.title: Sax ci Moom
hero.mainText:
"Saxleen ci man, ni ma saxe man ci sama bopp ci yeen. Ni carub reseñ tëlee meññal boppam, su saxul ci ndeyam, ni ngeen di tëlee meññ, su ngeen saxul ci man."
(Yowaan 15.4)

stores._note: Make sure to change links below to your app links. Customize the app store badges for iOS and Android - grab the name and path for the appropriate badges from the images/ folder, i.e.'images/app store badges/Download_on_the_App_Store_Badge_FR_RGB_blk_100517.svg' for French.
stores.heading: Yebleen ngir Android

_note:
'sections' is the alternating rows content section of your app landing page. You can add multiple sections with headlines, text, images, and links. Supports line breaks via '\n' or '
'. It will adjust to landscape or portrait images and also handle empty URLs if you want to just give info, not a link on one section.

sections.headline: Ñetti téree ngii...
sections.text: ...yu am solo ngir dimbali nit ñi, ñu sax ci Almasi bi. Man ngeena jàng walla ngeen déglu kàddu yu neexa dégg, ak mbind mu yomba gis, ànd ak ndigal yu lay amal njariñ saa su ne.

* Soo Bëgg Sore
* Jigéen yi ak Yàlla
* Fukki nettali ak ñaar ci mbirum Mucc
